title: Radiographer Blog
description: Technical blog sharing specialized medical imaging knowledge. Built on WordPress with SEO-focused structure.
overviewDesc: A site focused on image interpretation - analyzing medical images to detect abnormalities. Built from near-zero knowledge with 3 years of dedicated study, primarily interpreting real-world clinical cases found online.

timeline.flag: Built Blog as Web Dev Practice
timeline.desc: Struggled through local-to-production deployment and contact form setup, but completed the site.
Likely due to thin content, poor SEO, and being built on a subdirectory.
Migrated the site with an SEO-focused redesign.
Submitted and passed the Google AdSense review.
Shut down the blog after transitioning to software engineering.
